kind.value: Scheduler: hosted cloud or self-hosted open source

hosting.value: Postiz Cloud, or self-host it on your own server

pricingModel.value: Flat monthly plans, tiered by number of channels

freeOption.value: No free cloud plan; the self-hosted code is free to run

trial.value: 7-day trial; a payment method is required to start it

networks.value: 30 listed, including Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, YouTube, Threads, Pinterest, Reddit, Bluesky and Mastodon

api.value: Public API, CLI and webhooks on every plan

mcp.value: Hosted MCP server on every plan

ai.value: AI copilot on every plan, with monthly AI image, video and clipping allowances by plan

teams.value: Unlimited team members on Team, Pro and Ultimate; none on Standard

selfHostStack.value: Docker Compose with the app, PostgreSQL, Redis and Temporal (with its own PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch)

selfHostApps.value: Self-hosters get each network's developer app approved themselves; Postiz sells help with this as an optional service
